decisions.statement: A path's name alone says its kind.
A whole basename is read before any extension of that basename is.
A path ending `.ts` or `.tsx` is TypeScript.
Whether a path is TypeScript is answered from the ending alone.
A name ending `.template` is read as the same name without that ending.
A name no rule reaches says no kind rather than a kind meaning unknown.
A sops secret is not yaml.
A sops secret's keys are sops's own and its values are ciphertext.
The sops config is sops's own rules rather than a secret.
A jsonl file is one JSON value to a line.
Bash is a kind of sh.
Yml and yaml are one language under two endings.
A systemd timer stands on the service that timer starts.
A dot-name ending `ignore` has the path patterns a tool leaves alone.
Nothing here opens the file the path names.
Nothing here says whether a kind is text or bytes.
Nothing here says which module system loads a JavaScript file.
Nothing here tells an icon or a texture from a photograph.

definition: the kind of file a path's own name says the file is
